title: FDA NEWA De Novo review — DEN150005
finding: 69 enrolled; 62 completed; 59/62 met blinded wrinkle responder criterion. Home-use single-center study without sham. Original model only.
limits: Wrinkle endpoint is not human collagen biopsy or sham-adjusted success probability; no modern-brand superiority.

title: El-Domyati et al. RF facial rejuvenation — PMID21315951
finding: Six participants, types III-IV, six professional RF sessions over three months; biopsies showed increased collagen I/III and newly synthesized collagen.
limits: Small uncontrolled study, professional hardware; cannot quantify home results or comparative superiority.

title: El-Domyati et al. Multiple microneedling sessions — PMID26096653
finding: Ten participants, types III-IV, six sessions at two-week intervals. Biopsies at baseline, one and three months; collagen I/III/VII and new collagen increased.
limits: Small uncontrolled cohort, no direct energy-device comparison; professional needling data do not validate superficial home rollers.

title: Lee et al. Sham-controlled LED rejuvenation — PMID17566756
finding: 76 participants; 633nm, 830nm, combined or sham; twice weekly for four weeks, three-month follow-up. Wrinkle, elasticity and histology signals.
limits: Older study/platform; baseline maxima are not average sham-adjusted results for retail masks. Funding not extracted from abstract.

title: Wunsch and Matuschka controlled red/NIR trial — PMC3926176
finding: 136 included,128 completed; broad-spectrum lamps,30 sessions. Ultrasound collagen-density proxy and wrinkle/roughness improvements; no severe adverse events recorded.
limits: Non-sham control, commercial involvement, ultrasound proxy rather than biopsy; lamps were not modern LED masks.

title: Park SH, Park SO, Jung JA home LED/IRED crow's-feet trial — PMID39960921
finding: 60 Asian-descent participants, types II-V; multicenter randomized double-blind sham comparison of630/850nm home mask over16weeks. Wrinkle-grade differences at8,12,16weeks.
limits: Crow's-feet endpoint, not collagen biopsy or general face lift. Abstract uses anomalous mW/cm3 unit: not used as a dosing prescription. Conflicts require full-text extraction.

title: Suh et al. Focused ultrasound in Asian skin — PMID21806707
finding: 22 Korean patients, one professional focused-ultrasound treatment;11 biopsied at baseline/two months. Clinical and dermal-collagen signals.
limits: Uncontrolled; small sample cannot establish uncommon-harm incidence; no consumer-HIFU equivalence.

title: Werschler and Werschler MFU-V pilot — PMID27047630
finding: 20-person open-label pilot, assessments90/180days/one year. At one year6/14 evaluable subjects improved on blinded assessment despite high subjective ratings.
limits: Small uncontrolled pilot; attrition and assessor disagreement; protocol and device-specific.

title: Kauvar and Gershonowitz fractional RF pins — PMID34287975
finding: Nine participants, six sessions, typesII-IV; wrinkle score4.33to3.33 three months later. Histology was porcine, not a human biopsy endpoint.
limits: Open-label intraindividual design despite PubMed RCT tag; manufacturer affiliation/sponsor involvement; no adverse events in nine cannot exclude rare harm.

title: FDA RF microneedling safety communication — issued2025-10-15
finding: Reports include burns, scarring, fat loss, disfigurement and nerve damage; FDA states these devices should not be used at home.
limits: Reports do not supply comparative incidence; communication concerns certain uses of RF microneedling, not a blanket finding about every surface RF device.

title: Bu et al. YA-MAN/Jmoon home-device trial — PMID40099405
finding: 90 randomized,80 completed, four-week bundled home-device study with power-free control; imaging and wrinkle/texture/laxity signals. No physical-health improvement.
limits: Short follow-up, sensory mismatch, multiple modes plus gel and meridian technique; no collagen biopsy or established mapping to current retail SKUs.

title: Shu et al. Home RF randomized split-face trial — DOI10.1007/s13555-022-00697-y
finding: 33 enrolled,32 completed,12weeks;1MHz bipolar RF plus630nm LED and gel versus a different cosmetic. Wrinkle/thickness signals, no significant between-side hydration/elasticity difference.
limits: Unmatched topical comparator, unnamed retail model in primary methods; publication fee supported by Ecolite; does not isolate RF.

title: Panasonic EH-SR90 RF LUXE official features
finding: 1-6MHz modulated RF, dual EMS, red LED, ion modes; separate definitions for appearance, muscle-training lift and upward movement. Bench vitamin-C/glycerin uptake comparison.
limits: Manufacturer tests and mode descriptions do not show superior human collagen production versus other brands or isolate RF.

title: YA-MAN Bloom6 — YJFS16PN1 official specifications
finding: 0.5-2.5MHz RF, five-layer ring, resistance-factor feedback, contact sensing, EMS and redLED; country-of-origin Japan stated for this model.
limits: Marketing warmth comparisons, not validated universal treatment depth or superiority; inconsistent5/6minute summary wording requires exact IFU.

title: Medicube AGE-R Ultra Tune40.68 official US page
finding: RF+microcurrent; line/elasticity focus; six-contact activation and continuous movement instruction; brand application-test percentages.
limits: No complete controlled human collagen study supplied on reviewed page;40.68MHz number is not proof of superiority; regional IFU controls.

title: Medicube original Booster Pro official US page
finding: Delivery, microcurrent/EMS, Air Shot, LED and vibration multimode platform; glow/uptake focus.
limits: Original Booster Pro must be distinguished from later X2 and Ultra Tune; uptake tests do not measure durable collagen remodelling.

title: ARTISTIC&CO ZeusIV launch —2025-05-31
finding: Describes EMS, HEAT, LED and MFIP integrated by treatment algorithm.
limits: HEAT does not by itself establish RF; proprietary pulse names and price are not a collagen trial.

title: ReFa CARAT LIFT official English page
finding: EMS-equipped microcurrent roller platform; rolling and facial muscle stimulation focus.
limits: Cannot import RF evidence from another ReFa model into a roller, or infer human collagen synthesis from muscle contraction.

title: ReFa BEAUTECH RAISE regional official page
finding: RF-Wpulse bundles RF, sonic and PI pulses; serum-compatible routine platform.
limits: Regional model; proprietary naming does not establish comparative delivery or collagen benefit.

title: LG Pra.L Hong Kong lineup announcement —2024
finding: Separate Dermathera ultrasound, multi-energy care and LED/delivery lanes; Dermathera angle-sensing safeguard described.
limits: 2024 regional announcement is not verified2026 global availability; ultrasound modes must be assessed by model.

title: FDA LG Pra.L Derma LED Mask — K183671
finding: Regulatory device description and wrinkle indication for the specific LED mask.
limits: 510(k) is not proof all LG products have equal outcomes, or a head-to-head superiority finding.

title: AMIRO R1 PRO official global product page
finding: RF, EMS/microcurrent-labelled mode, red/NIR and temperature-control marketing;3mm depth and percentage claims.
limits: Claims not independently verified;3mm not a measured uniform map; regional price/SKU discrepancies; no grade based on customer stars.

title: Jmoon official model2 specification page
finding: Reviewed model lists0.8-2.7MHz RF and red/green/orange light; multi-mode contour/eye/face focus.
limits: Cannot equate this catalog model with2025 trial hardware or translate collagen-light nickname into proven collagen synthesis.

title: FDA CurrentBody Skin RF — K232424
finding: 1MHz bipolar RF and40.5plus/minus0.5C regulation; bench/substantial-equivalence evidence.
limits: No new subject-device controlled clinical superiority; disclosed controls are documentation strength, not effect-size ranking.

title: FDA Sensilift Pro — K250341
finding: 1MHz bipolar platform, redundant thermistors and40plus/minus0.5C regulation in archive extraction.
limits: No new subject-device clinical comparison; confirm model-specific indication/exclusions.

title: FDA Sofwave lifting indications — K211483
finding: Professional ultrasound, eyebrow/submental/neck indications and clinical-performance summary; different geometry from deep MFU.
limits: Not an OTC home ultrasound template; indications differ by filing and body site.
